args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 for `checkout-api` describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is pending. The on-call engineer was paged.
